posts.text:
See the fees. Know the trade-offs.
FeeEye brings crypto fee research, calculators and beginner guides together. Start with the risks and questions to ask before you trade.
https://feeeye.com/learn/?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=feeeye-launch

A trading fee is only one part of the bill. Spread, slippage, funding and withdrawal costs need separate checks. Learn what to include before comparing platforms.
https://feeeye.com/learn/crypto-total-cost?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=feeeye-launch

Before sending crypto: check the asset, receiving network, address and any required memo. A familiar token name does not make every network compatible.
https://feeeye.com/learn/safe-crypto-transfer?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=feeeye-launch

看清费用，也看清取舍。FeeEye把费用研究、计算工具和新手教程放在一起。先了解风险和交易前该问的问题，再考虑下一步。
https://feeeye.com/zh/learn/?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=feeeye-launch

交易手续费不是全部账单。价差、滑点、入金和提币成本，都需要单独检查。比较平台前，先了解哪些成本不能漏算。
https://feeeye.com/zh/learn/crypto-total-cost?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=feeeye-launch

转账前，核对资产、接收网络、地址和必要的Memo。币名一样，不代表所有网络都能互通。先用检查清单逐项确认。
https://feeeye.com/zh/learn/safe-crypto-transfer?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=feeeye-launch
